official_specification.name: MCP Specification (2026-07-28) — current
official_specification.description: Current protocol version, shipped 2026-07-28. Stateless (no initialize handshake, no Mcp-Session-Id), server/discover RPC, MRTR replaces server-initiated requests. Verified 2026-08-11

official_specification.name: MCP Changelog (2026-07-28)
official_specification.description: Authoritative list of changes since 2025-11-25: stateless protocol (SEP-2567/2575), MRTR (SEP-2322), Roots/Sampling/Logging deprecated (SEP-2577), feature lifecycle with 12-month minimum deprecation window (SEP-2596). Verified 2026-08-11

official_specification.name: MCP Deprecated Features Registry (2026-07-28)
official_specification.description: Live registry of every feature currently in the Deprecated state. Check before relying on Roots, Sampling, Logging, HTTP+SSE transport, or OAuth Dynamic Client Registration — the 12-month window is a floor, not a removal date

official_specification.name: MCP Specification (2025-11-25) — superseded
official_specification.description: Previous protocol baseline, superseded by 2026-07-28. Consult only when maintaining a server still pinned to this version

governance.name: MCP Joins the Agentic AI Foundation (official MCP blog)
governance.description: Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), a directed fund under the Linux Foundation, effective 2025-12-09. Existing maintainers keep full technical authority via the SEP process; the foundation provides neutral governance infrastructure and does not set technical direction. Founding members: Anthropic, Block, OpenAI, with AWS, Google, Microsoft, Cloudflare, Bloomberg support. Verified 2026-07-11

community_resources.name: Agent Tools & Interoperability with MCP (Google whitepaper)
community_resources.description: Styer, Patlolla, Mohan, Diaz; Google, November 2025. Read from the local repo copy at custom-gpt/programming/AI Agents/sources/6. Google Agent Tools & Interoperability with Model Context Protocol (MCP).pdf; the exact public download URL is UNVERIFIED - the link here is the Google/Kaggle whitepaper series landing page, confirm before citing externally. Source for references/mcp-security.md server-mutation threat taxonomy: Dynamic Capability Injection and Tool Shadowing with mitigations (pp. 40-44), taint source/sink tagging (p. 46), confused-deputy worked example (pp. 49-51), retrieval-index poisoning (pp. 37-38). Threat taxonomy only - its spec-level claims predate the 2026-07-28 redesign and are superseded by SKILL.md.
